text: Hi all who can help clear the winter beds on saturday? Pumpkin stalks and the old bean poles need to come out before the frost sets in properly
I can be there. What time?
10 maybe? Bring gloves, the stalks are prickly
im in ill bring my own gloves but cant come before 11 bc of my mum's thing
11 works fine
Cant sat, am on the ward til 14:00. Sorry 😕 will come sunday if thats ok?
Sunday works
saturday im on from 10 at the restaurant lunch rush. could maybe come after 13?
or i come straight from work if its not too late 🤷‍♂️🥶
Frost on everything 🥶 stalks will be stiff but easier to pull
Here. Gate was open. Back beds or front?
Back beds by the compost. Shed key's on the hook inside the door
Found it.
[photo: pumpkin stalks piled against the fence]
Ooh thats more than I thought
omw 🚲 bus was a joke
Ok start with the far row, Jens is on the poles
still at work 😩 lunch rush wont stop. prob 14:30 at the earliest 🥶
No worries, we left your gloves on the bench
Bean poles all out. About a third of the stakes are rotten at the base. I'll bin them on the way out.
Great thanks. Rotten ones go in the green bin not compost
Off shift. Sorry again 😕 how far did you get
Back two beds done, front row tomorrow prob. Sunday still good?
Yes! Ill bring the tea thermos
just got here, hands already freezing where do u want me
Kale bed, can you pull the dead chard? Roots come up easy if you wiggle
off. legs gone 😵‍💫 coming now or did u all leave
Still here. Going soon, my back has had enough.
Were nearly done, bean bed still needs turning. Come if you want
ill come
home 🏠 shower done, cant feel my fingers 🥶 thanks Jens for binning the rotten stakes 🙏
and i can come early tomorrow to help finish the front row if ppl want 🌱 im up anyway lol
Morning. Frost again front row still has stakes and the chard roots. Wheelbarrow is in the shed if anyone needs it
I'll be there around 10.
Thermos is filled. Be there by 11
ill be there around 11:30 sorry, mums thing ran over
No problem 👍
[photo: frost on the front bed edging]
Stakes out. Chard roots are harder than they look.
Wiggle them like I said
I did wiggle them.
just woke up 😵 ppl still there?? cant come before 13 my feet still hate me
Some of us. Come when you can
Here. Hands are already cold. Tea on the bench
here!! where u want me
Bean bed, the turning is heavy, tag team with Jens
ok
on my way
[photo: compost heap steaming in the cold]
Is that the compost or the Tobias bike?
😂 compost 🌱
Front row is clear. Thanks all, it looks properly winter now
Good. Thermos is empty so I'm calling it 🙂
ok bye!! heading home, my hands are dead
Going too. Gate is locked, I checked it.
Did anyone leave the shed light on? I think I saw it from the bus stop
i did 😬 sorry, turning it off now
Thanks
Night all 😴
cant sleep anyone up
